name: fifteen stacks
title: A broken stack shouldn't stall the whole rollout
label: cluster-a failed because SQS refuses a FIFO queue whose name lacks .fifo. Its six apps are blocked; cluster-b's six went ahead.

chapter.headline: cluster-a breaks. Only its 6 apps stop; the other 8 stacks ship anyway

about.changes: A pull request (a change up for review) edits the shared network. It also adds a cluster-a queue whose name AWS refuses.
about.watch: chant plans fifteen stacks in three waves. After the merge, network applies first. Then cluster-a fails and its six apps are blocked. Cluster-b's six apps go ahead. A fix applies the seven left.
about.shows: A failure blocks only the stacks that depend on it, and the fix applies only what was left.
